review_kind: fresh independent Phase 0 adversarial review of v5

reviewer.lens: exact locally decidable grammar, ADR conformance, trusted interfaces, and non-authorizing boundary

scope_checked: trusted interfaces, opacity, effects, and RED scope

findings.invariant: The preflight must use an allowed frozen interface and truthfully identify dependency routes.
findings.evidence: v5 requires exact calls to trust._load_canonical_json and trust._canonical_bytes, but both are private and absent from trust.__all__. Its RED map also demands a test that there is no trust.py route. Public frozen interfaces expose ReleaseKeyring and TrustedClock, not canonical JSON.
findings.worked_counterexample: Importing the helpers violates the private API contract and fails the stated no-trust-route test; copying the recipe violates the required exact frozen calls and can drift when trust changes.
findings.consequence: No green class can satisfy v5, its frozen interface, and its own RED assertion. Canonical bytes determine every accepted self-digest/signature preimage.
findings.required_correction: Expose and pin a public canonical interface, or specify an independent algorithm and remove the exact-call/no-trust-route claims before RED.

findings.invariant: A local-link rule may reference only fields in every claimed closed schema.
findings.evidence: The common rule says CES/PEA/BVP/CAS each carry component_manifest_sha256. CAS own v5 schema and ADR exact CAS shape omit that field.
findings.worked_counterexample: An ADR-shaped CAS cannot supply the required comparison. An implementation must reject every valid CAS, skip the link, or add a forbidden extra key.
findings.consequence: The profile/direct-link rule is internally unimplementable.
findings.required_correction: Limit component-manifest equality to CES/PEA/BVP and compare only fields CAS carries; add a targeted RED mutation.

findings.invariant: A supplied subject must deterministically bind its matching supplied Scope child before profile checks.
findings.evidence: v5 invokes the selected Scope child without defining selection. It never requires ActionSubject ID/digest or ReplaySubject ID/digest to equal exactly one Scope child. Admission binds only to subject.
findings.worked_counterexample: Scope has A2 digest h_scope, while CES/PEA/BVP/CAS/admission use ActionSubject(A2,h_other); a different Scope child can share contract/component fields. Stated comparisons can pass without a matching Scope intent.
findings.consequence: A locally supplied intent substitution passes claimed direct checks, contrary to ADR matching ActionIntent/ReplayIntent contract rule.
findings.required_correction: Define selection as the unique Scope entry with subject ID and self digest, then apply profile-kind and field comparisons.

findings.invariant: Every locally supplied root ActionIntent input ID must identify a supplied root-PIS entry.
findings.evidence: v5 checks root_published_input_ids only for sorted uniqueness. It never requires membership in root_pis.entries even though root PIS bytes are supplied and ADR says a root has only root PIS input IDs.
findings.worked_counterexample: A root declares not-in-root-pis while all signatures, six-action set, edge bytes, and profiles pass.
findings.consequence: The claimed locally closed DAG accepts a directly supplied input substitution; P0-0045-M04 is not resolved.
findings.required_correction: Require exactly-one root-PIS membership for every root input ID and test absent/duplicate/substituted IDs.

findings.invariant: An exact canonical grammar must state each array-sort comparator.
findings.evidence: v5 says sorted by IDs, tuples, or complete canonical items but never chooses decoded Unicode, escaped JSON text, or canonical-byte lexicographic comparison. trust._canonical_bytes orders object keys but not arrays.
findings.worked_counterexample: For IDs z and e-acute, decoded-string order is z then e-acute, while ASCII canonical JSON item bytes order escaped e-acute before z. Both can claim sorted under v5 and accept different signed bytes.
findings.consequence: Order refusal and signature acceptance vary by implementation; the promised exact locally decidable grammar is false.
findings.required_correction: Pin one comparator and tie/uniqueness rule for every sort and add a non-ASCII order mutation to RED.

resolved_from_0045.P0-0045-M01: 11 positions/eight signed are coherent; v5 correctly limits equality to P(CES)==P(CAS), not P(BVP).
resolved_from_0045.P0-0045-M02: Most fields are explicit, but CAS-link and ordering Majors remain.
resolved_from_0045.P0-0045-M03: Narrowed non-ADR-verification claims correctly leave basis external.
resolved_from_0045.P0-0045-M04: Action/edge bytes are supplied, but Scope-subject and root-PIS links are omitted.
resolved_from_0045.P0-0045-M05: Revocation prose is fail-closed but cannot repair the private canonicalization dependency.

assessment.non_authorizing_boundary: v5 stated opaque value denies capture/session/WORM authority; no contrary matrix route was found.
assessment.red_scope: RED is proportionate only after repair: it cannot test a valid CAS component comparison, unambiguously select Scope, assert one canonical order, or reconcile its no-trust-route test.

summary.reason: v5 narrows v4 overclaims, but five Majors keep the preflight internally inconsistent, under-specified, or incomplete for directly supplied facts.

required_next_gate: Repair all five Majors and obtain a fresh independent Phase 0 review before RED work.
